name: aura
species: ribbons of colored light swirling slowly inside the glass

name: droplet
species: the body itself deforms: a zero-g liquid sphere wobbling organically, breathing with voice

name: nebula
species: volumetric mist folding inside, stirred by thinking

name: prism
species: light entering and softly splitting inside the sphere

name: limn
species: near-dark glass whose edge is alive: a traveling rim of light thickening with voice

name: duet
species: two lights orbiting each other inside: the conversation

name: fathom
species: layered translucent depths, parallax inside the glass

name: arc
species: one soft bright filament arcing gently within

name: opal
species: internal play-of-color: soft opalescent flashes drifting through

name: comet
species: a bright point orbiting inside, leaving a fading trail; parseable at 18 pt

name: still
species: the minimal hero: a quiet glass sphere, one slow internal glint

name: flux
species: an aurora streaming inside the glass

name: tempest
species: a contained storm: weather churning in the glass, lightning-soft flickers buried deep in the cloud, never at the surface

name: helix
species: a double strand of light slowly climbing and rotating inside

name: geode
species: crystalline facets inside the glass catching light as the body turns

name: sol
species: a miniature sun: soft prominences lifting and falling inside

name: abyss
species: deep-sea dark glass: rare bioluminescent glows passing through, mostly night

name: chorus
species: many faint lights breathing loosely, falling into alignment while responding

name: eddy
species: thought circling a center: a slow rotational shear field, light caught in the turn

name: well
species: pulling inward: light and density drawn toward a deep center that never fills

name: tide
species: a slow wash crossing the frame and returning, weight leaning with it

name: undertow
species: two layers sliding opposite ways, structure born where they shear

name: meander
species: one bright channel wandering through dark mass, the path is the thought

name: confluence
species: two flows finding each other and joining; joined is the rest state

name: melt
species: a heavy molten mass slowly melting and reforming, viscous, drips absorbed back into the body

name: glaze
species: a thin bright sheet of liquid sliding over a dark form, light traveling in the film

name: bloom
species: ink meeting water: a front advancing with a live fBm edge, settling saturated

name: marbling
species: combed ink: layered laminar folds sliding past each other, suminagashi tempo

name: wick
species: ink drawn upward through fiber: capillary creep, gravity in reverse, grain of the paper visible in the climb

name: strata
species: sediment settling into layers: horizontal density bands finding their level

name: halation
species: a dark mass wearing its own light: soft halo shifting as the mass slowly reforms

name: pool
species: ink already at rest, meniscus alive: the stillest style in the set, surface tension doing the thinking

name: feather
species: ink feathering along paper fibers: a directional bleed advancing hair by hair, then resting saturated

name: palimpsest
species: older writing ghosting up through the surface, almost legible, reabsorbed before it resolves

name: caustic
species: light refracted through moving water onto a floor: the web, soft, never cellular

name: aurora
species: a curtain of light folding in slow air, horizontal grammar, nothing falls

name: ember
species: heat above a warm floor: shimmer rising, light pooled low

name: lantern
species: one light behind moving fog: presence felt through a medium, never seen directly

name: mirage
species: horizontal refraction bands bending a distant light, the desert-road shimmer

name: oculus
species: a soft aperture admitting light, opening as thought completes; open is rest

name: dapple
species: canopy light: soft patches through moving leaves, the shade breathing across the floor

name: eclipse
species: a slow occluder drifting across a light, the corona doing the talking at the edge

name: murmuration
species: the namesake: a flock as one soft mass, density turning and folding over itself, individuals never resolvable

name: loom
species: threads finding a weave: warp and weft interference resolving into cloth and relaxing again

name: cipher
species: meaning surfacing: latent structure in a dark field, revealed where a slow attention passes

name: tuning
species: static finding the station: broadband noise narrowing toward a coherent line; coherent is rest, noise never fully gone

name: current
species: signal moving through a medium: impulses traveling a soft network, felt as moving light, never drawn as wires

name: veil
species: layers of translucency sliding: what is behind almost legible, parallax as depth of thought

name: echo
species: a soft form answered by its own fading repetitions, each displaced and softer than the last, never rings

name: glyph
species: almost-writing: marks forming out of ink and dissolving before they resolve into letters

name: breathe
species: the resting orb: the whole lattice inhaling and exhaling slowly, depth carrying the breath

name: orbit
species: latitude bands of dots streaming around the sphere at neighboring speeds

name: glimmer
species: scattered dots catching light in sequence, a constellation being counted

name: vortex
species: the lattice swirling toward a pole, drawn and released

name: gather
species: dots converging from dispersion into one bright ring; ringed is the rest state

name: stir
species: dots jostled from their lattice seats and settling back, the sphere thinking with its hands

name: daybreak
species: a terminator of light sweeping the sphere, dawn crossing a small planet

name: skein
species: dots strung along a winding thread wrapping the sphere, wound and unwound

name: halo
species: a thin luminous ring tilting in 3D like a coin's edge; voice travels its circumference as a wave, never bars

name: nucleus
species: a steady bright core wearing a shell of circulating mist; voice swells the shell, success collapses it into the core

name: iris
species: an aperture of soft light petals; voice opens it, silence closes it to a slit glow

name: filament
species: one continuous thread of light: knotting loosely while thinking, taut while responding, coiled at rest

name: flare
species: a soft solar disc whose edge sprouts short organic licks with voice level; a sun, never an EQ

name: braid
species: two strands orbiting a common center: loose at idle, braided tight while responding; the conversation itself

name: mote
species: the minimal presence: one soft light wandering a small path, leaning toward typing, stretching slightly with voice; designed at 18 pt first

name: ripple
species: a still face-on liquid disc where input lands: each impulse of activity drops one soft propagating ring
